exercises.why: **Введите** — ввести́ (perfective): to introduce; to bring in, to usher in; to input. Wiktionary: в- + вести́.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to lead, to conduct, to direct, to drive
to lead away; to take / draw aside; to take away
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: приводи́ть — to bring (someone with); повести́ — to lead, to conduct, to direct, to drive; отвести́ — to lead away; to take / draw aside; to take away; ввести́ — to introduce.

exercises.q: There's no need to see them off.
exercises.why: **провожать** — провожа́ть (imperfective): to escort, to accompany, to see off. Wiktionary: проводи́ть + -а́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: He accompanied me on the way home.
exercises.why: **провожал** — провожа́ть (imperfective): to escort, to accompany, to see off. Wiktionary: проводи́ть + -а́ть.
